_comment: Assumptions, not data. Replace each with measured values as soon as they exist (ledger, subscriptions, marketplace reports).

models.name: B03 Confluence Cloud accessibility checker (Atlassian Marketplace, Forge)

sources.platform_fee: 0% on first $1M lifetime Forge revenue from 2026-01-01, then standard Forge rate (17% from 2026-10-01) [S31]. Modeled at 17% throughout = conservative.
sources.payment: Atlassian bills the customer; no separate payment processor [S32].
sources.arpu: UNVERIFIED ASSUMPTION. Cloud apps are priced by the customer's user tier [S32]; $150/mo implies roughly a few hundred-user org at sub-$1/user. Must be checked against competitor price tiers before build.
sources.variable_cost: Assumed Forge compute/storage within free allowances plus support time; Forge pricing beyond free tier is announced but not modeled [S31].
sources.cac: Organic marketplace + SEO; $60 = allocated listing/content/tooling cost per customer. Assumption.
sources.churn: Assumption: B2B compliance tooling with annual Atlassian licences; 2%/mo base, 4%/mo stress.
sources.fixed_costs: M1-M3 domain/tools; M4 adds monitoring and error tracking; M5-M6 add part-time support contractor (~20-40 h/mo) and bookkeeping.

models.name: B01 Lightweight trust center + questionnaire library for <50-person B2B SaaS (Stripe)

sources.arpu: Below incumbents ($5k-$20k/yr: SafeBase, Conveyor, Vanta [S26,S27]) but above free tiers (TrustCloud <20 employees, ShieldPage free/$49 [S26]). Assumption.
sources.payment: Stripe standard US card pricing 2.9% + $0.30 (verify at signup).
sources.variable_cost: Hosting + LLM calls for questionnaire drafting; assumption, capped by config.
sources.cac: SEO + product-led trust-page footer; assumption. Higher than B03 because there is no marketplace with built-in buyer search.
sources.churn: Small-SaaS customers churn when they fail or outgrow; 3% base, 6% stress. Assumption.

models.name: B04 Shopify accessibility audit app (Shopify App Store)

sources.platform_fee: 0% revenue share on first $1M (reduced plan, $19 one-time registration) [S14]; 2.9% processing fee on app billing [S14].
sources.churn: Small-merchant apps churn fast; 6% base, 10% stress. Assumption.
